description.text: Start Deck 100 Battle Collection, released on 19 December 2025, four years after the first Start Deck 100: 100 different ready-built 60-card decks for starting the game, each with its own Pokémon and way of playing, one of them in each box at random with a sheet of damage counters and markers. Two decks are needed for a game. Some decks hold an ACE SPEC, among them Precious Trolley, first printed in the Sylveon ex starter set of 2024. Besides the 742 numbered cards, this set holds 24 full-illustration cards numbered from 743 to 766 and the eight basic Energy.
